Path 3, fleetGOALS §5.1

Karmada

A genuine multi-cluster scheduler, for workloads that must move.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Incubating control plane that propagates workloads across clusters with placement policies, cluster affinities, failover with toleration windows, and replica division across survivors.

WHAT SETS IT APART

It reschedules on cluster failure, which ApplicationSets can't. Bloomberg runs streaming on it for exactly that.

WHERE WE STAND

Watch, until decision 2 says we have workloads that can't run active-active. If the list is empty, it stays here.

"Karmada Updates and Use Cases" (Bloomberg, Huawei), KubeCon NA 2026
